property_summary: For any addresses caller and newOwner, when the current owner directly calls setOwner(newOwner) the contract's owner becomes newOwner (reference guarantees only direct caller who equals owner can change owner); the mutant that uses tx.origin can be changed by an intermediate contract call where msg.sender != owner but tx.origin == owner, so there exist inputs (an intermediate contract address) that make the mutant's owner differ.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner require to compare against tx.origin instead of owner, altering who can call setOwner and thus affecting final owner.
